from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,statistics,random,math,csv
OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;AP1=OUT.with_name('ap1-measurement');sys.path.insert(0,str(AP1));import run as r;r.OUT=OUT
screen=r.load(OUT/'actual-screen.json');ids=(OUT/'actual-cases.tsv').read_text().splitlines();assert len(screen['cases'])==len(ids)==11
cases=[]
for raw,source in zip(screen['cases'],ids):
 path,stem=source.split('\t');assert raw['stem']==stem
 p=statistics.median(raw['parent_us']);c=statistics.median(raw['candidate_us']);cases.append({**raw,'capture_root':path,'gain':p/c-1})
assert all(c['gain']>0 for c in cases)
rng=random.Random(20261104);boots=[]
for _ in range(10000):boots.append(math.exp(statistics.mean(math.log(statistics.median(rng.choices(c['parent_us'],k=10))/statistics.median(rng.choices(c['candidate_us'],k=10))) for c in cases))-1)
boots.sort();summary={'actual_cases':cases,'all_partial_lse_merge_bit_exact':True,'all_case_medians_positive':True,'geomean_gain':math.exp(statistics.mean(math.log(1+c['gain']) for c in cases))-1,'bootstrap95':[boots[250],boots[9749]],'scope':'actualR1Target+Assistant inputs;cache-warm alternating16-launch graphs;notprimarythroughput'}
assert summary['bootstrap95'][0]>0
with (OUT/'operator-summary.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(summary,f,indent=2)
print('OPERATOR GATE',summary['geomean_gain'],summary['bootstrap95'],flush=True)
for role,pattern in [('parent','SplitOnlineDecodeAttentionFp8GlobalKvh2Kernel'),('candidate','Ap3GlobalR1WarpNormKernel')]:
 r.idle_and_cool();label='counter-r1-'+role
 r.run(label,['ncu','--kernel-name','regex:.*'+pattern+'.*','--launch-count','1','--clock-control','none','--cache-control','none','--section','LaunchStats','--section','SourceCounters','--section','WarpStateStats','-o',str(OUT/label),str(OUT/'r1-screen'),str(OUT/'actual-cases.tsv'),'screen',str(OUT/(label+'-diagnostic.json'))],180)
 reports=list(OUT.glob(label+'.ncu-rep*'));assert len(reports)==1
 r.run(label+'-export',['ncu','--import',str(reports[0]),'--page','raw','--csv'],30)
 print('COUNTER SAVED',role,flush=True)
for tool in ['memcheck','synccheck']:

 assert 'ERROR SUMMARY: 0 errors' in (OUT/(label+'.sanitizer.log')).read_text()
